partitions.purpose: Standby kernel image for A/B OTA fallback.
Active root filesystem (UBI/UBIFS) containing Core RDK-B components; no WAN stack loaded for this profile.
Standby root filesystem for A/B OTA fallback.
PSM/TR-181 persistent data store; survives OTA and factory reset boundary per policy.
Radio calibration data, MAC addresses, serial number; written at manufacturing.

notes: Partition classes reflect what Core RDK-B's firmware-upgrade HAL and A/B OTA model require to exist (see Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 4.3), not a specific vendor's partition table. Sizes are not yet measured against a built image. Rootfs is expected to be smaller than EthWAN WiFi Router's since no WAN stack is loaded (see Section 3.1 sizing notes), but this has not been confirmed against an actual image. Exact byte offsets, bootloader partition sizing, and calibration data layout are OEM/SoC-vendor-specific and out of scope for Core RDK-B (see Section 3.3).
